name: props-ladder-discount
why: Six props agents are barren and recent supplied props replay evidence is sparse and negative. Test a distinct structural hypothesis rather than another unconditional favourite band: a lower numeric threshold's YES, or a higher threshold's NO, should not cost less than a strictly harder outcome for the same player and settlement event. Require matching ticker/question identity, a persistent executable-quote inversion, liquid narrow-spread references, a conservative full-taker fee reserve, post-only execution, explicit resolution within 48 hours and one exposure capped at $2 including reserved fees. Relative prices are not true probabilities and this long-only trade is not an arbitrage; asynchronous quotes, an overpriced reference and adverse selection may defeat it. Missing metadata or insufficient observations must reject the hypothesis rather than induce forced turnover. This unexecuted candidate starts at rung 0, retains all applicable selection history and requires sufficient after-cost replay evidence, independent paper fills and settlements, audit and ordinary capital qualification.
